crossRefs.note: Saul knew David’s voice, and said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” David said, “It is my voice, my lord, O king.”
As soon as the boy was gone, David arose out of the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three…
When Abigail saw David, she hurried and got off her donkey, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the…
She fell at his feet, and said, “On me, my lord, on me be the blame! Please let your servant speak in your ears. Hear…
Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect…
Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.
translations.bsb: After that, David got up, went out of the cave, and called out to Saul, “My lord the king!” When Saul looked behind him, David bowed facedown in reverence
translations.kjv: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
translations.asv: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and did obeisance.
